
# Configs updated for Wuthering Waves v3.6.
## Added Community Configs - LowEnd from Kodoupulse

## High Visuals Configs

| Config | Description | Recomm. RAM +
|---|---|---|
| HighVisual | High quality characters and textures, balanced performance | 16GB|
| Z_Experimental | Alternative to HighVisual if you experience issues | 12GB|
| Community Configs - Mythos Overdrive | Custom High-visual config| 16GB |
> Both use dp.Override to Adreno840, in case frame gen is not working for you because you use mediatek, switch the name from Adreno840 to MTK_6991

## Stable Configs

| Config | Target Device | Recomm. RAM |
|---|---|---|
| Stable_A | High-end devices| 12GB |
| Stable_B | Mid-end devices | 12GB |
| Stable_C | Low-end devices | 8GB |

## Performance Configs

| Config | Description | Recomm. RAM |
|---|---|---|
| Config_1 | High quality characters and textures, no shadows, no/minimal reflections | 8GB |
| Config_2 | Minimal config (near-vanilla), high TAA | 12 GB |
| Potato Config | For low-end phones struggling to play WuWa | ~8GB |
| Community Configs - Kudoupulse Low End Config| For Low end units | <8GB | 

All configs are patched with the bike fix for frame-gen enabled gameplay.
Credits to everyone in the README.md, in the config servers and to the reddit community.  

🙏 Thanks to everyone who tested and reported issues.

Final Notes:
We're trying to find a possible workaround for C# for those who does not have at least 8GB.
